name: Kan'u Unchou
source:
One of the main female protagonists and main heroines in the Koihime†Musou series, Kan'u shows up shortly after [url=/c204]Kazuto[/url] is transported back in time and saves him from a group of bandits. Due to Kazuto's strange attire and manner of speech, she subsequently mistakes him to be the "Messenger from Heaven" and becomes the first person to vow her loyalty to him.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Koihime_Mus%C5%8D_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
